title: The Union-Closed Sets Conjecture
exact_target: Must some element occur in at least half the sets of every nontrivial finite family closed under unions?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1131 (COMB-003). CC BY 4.0.
Abigail Raz, \emph{Note on the union-closed sets conjecture}, arXiv:1704.07022 (2017), Section 1.
